bounds.interpretation: Polynomial Bernstein hulls bound center displacement and ring radii continuously. Orthogonal rotation gives ||qR-I|| <= 1+q. Subdivided Bezier chords/control polygons enclose both centerline lengths. These are bounds on the declared interpolated sweep, not a replacement for finite-triangle/contact checks.

sections.interpretation: Longitudinal sample sections; each determinant is affine in radial disk coordinates, so its reported angular/disk minimum is exact for that section. This is not a global interval proof of the volume Jacobian.

Subdivided Bezier chords/control polygons enclose both centerline lengths. These are bounds on the declared interpolated sweep, not a replacement for finite-triangle/contact checks.
